memories.memory: `kiro-cli chat` can't disable saving, and `--list-sessions` ignores `--format json`.
`/chat list` slows down as automated `--no-interactive` runs fill `conversations_v2`.
Kiro saves conversations per working directory, so `/chat` only lists sessions from the current directory.
To delete Kiro conversations safely, back up the database first, then vacuum and check integrity.
On the v3 engine, Kiro's read tool refuses paths that match git's global ignore file.
Agent `resources` globs like `dir/*.md` match only that directory, not subdirectories.
